Create a stamp with script path, output file path and time stamp in it.

Source: R/createStamp.R
createStamp.Rd

Create a stamp with script path, output file path and time stamp in it.

Usage

createStamp(
  file,
  script,
  time,
  model,
  addto,
  stamp.format,
  stamp.funs = list(script = function(x) paste("Script:", x), time = function(x)
    paste("Time:", if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) format(x, "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M") else x),
    model = function(x) paste("Model:", x), file = function(x) paste("Output:", x))
)

Arguments

file

the output file path

script

The script path

time

The default is to insert a time stamp taken from result of Sys.time(). Using the time argument you can overrule this by setting a fixed string instead. Use "" to omit.

model

An optional model name or object to be included in the stamp.

addto

An existing caption to keep above the caption created by this function.

stamp.format

A template for the stamp text using the placeholders %script, %time, %model, and %file. Use "\n" for line breaks. Placeholders without a value are removed, together with the resulting repeated spaces and empty lines. Default is "%file\n%script\n%model\n%time".

stamp.funs

Named list of functions used to preprocess script, time, model, and/or file before they are substituted into stamp.format. Each function takes the value as its single argument and returns a character string. By default, values are prefixed with "Output:", "Script:", "Model:" and "Time:", and time is formatted as "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M" if it is a POSIXct. Elements not supplied keep their defaults, so e.g. stamp.funs = list(file = basename) only changes file. Model and script objects (lists) are reduced to their label element before preprocessing.

Value

A character string, or NULL if neither script nor model is given.
